"If this is put into a graveyard from anywhere other than the combat chain, banish the top card of your deck and lose 1{h}. IF IT has 6 or more {p}, put IT into your hand, otherwise REPEAT THIS PROCESS."

Every "it" pointed at the wrong object. The power test was ATTACK_POWER_GTE, which asks about the attack on the chain -- this card is being put into a GRAVEYARD, so there need not be one -- where "it" is the card just banished; that is REF_POWER_GTE over the ref BANISH records. RETURN_TO_HAND with no ref returns the SOURCE, so the branch would have put Beast Within itself into hand rather than the banished card. And the gate was NOT(REF_EXISTS "COMBATCHAINLINK"), a ref nothing sets, so NOT(nothing) was TRUE in every state -- including the one case the card excludes.

NOT implemented, and removed rather than replaced with something else: "otherwise, REPEAT THIS PROCESS" is a loop, and there is no repeat primitive. The `else` branch had been PUT_SELF_BOTTOM_DECK, which is neither the repeat nor anything the card says. Definition of done: a bounded REPEAT effect exists and the else branch becomes one.
